task: Fix HTTP 500 on CLI Analytics endpoints by enforcing a consistent UTC timezone policy at the parameter acceptance boundary and the TimeParser utility to eliminate unhandled naive-vs-aware datetime comparisons.

key_reasoning.reason: Four source components must change — TimeParser._parse_custom_range (shared utility), AnalyticsFilterParams in _common.py, inline params in cli.py for /cli-summary, and FilterParams in cli_analytics.py (OTel path). TimeParser is called 20+ times across CLIHandler, BaseHandler, QueryPipeline, and CLIInsightsHandler; a shared-utility red flag bumped this from L to XL. Even though the fix at each site is small, the component surface is wider than a single-component bug fix.

Root cause and affected files are fully confirmed. The timezone-policy open question has since been resolved (normalize to UTC, stakeholder-confirmed 2026-10-29). analytics-cli.js (the CLI normalization counterpart cited in the task) is absent from this repository; its scope is out of scope for this story and tracked separately.

The Pydantic @field_validator pattern is established in this codebase and the fix is backward compatible. However, a testing auto-bump applies: test_time_parser.py never supplies a naive datetime to _parse_custom_range, and test_analytics.py line 1072 explicitly asserts HTTP 500 for the broken behavior — it must be inverted to expect HTTP 200 (normalized) per the resolved policy. No existing test template covers this defensive naive-datetime path, requiring net-new edge-case assertions.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L(4) to XL(5): TimeParser is a core shared utility called 20+ times across CLIHandler, BaseHandler, QueryPipeline, and CLIInsightsHandler — 'Touches core shared utilities' red flag applied.

Technical Risk confirmed at M(3) via testing auto-bump: no existing test in test_time_parser.py exercises naive datetime inputs, and test_analytics.py line 1072 documents the broken HTTP 500 behavior and must be updated — no existing test template covers this defensive pattern.
